events.description: A physical altercation erupts on the court sidelines during a high school basketball game, involving multiple individuals including players and adults; visible pushing and grabbing occurs near the scorer's table.
Multiple players from opposing teams engage in mutual physical combat near the sideline, including pushing, grabbing, and close confrontation; referees and coaches intervene to separate them.

Multiple players from opposing teams (white/red vs. gray jerseys) engage in mutual physical combat, including pushing, shoving, and grabbing, escalating into a large on-court brawl involving players, coaches, and referees.

The brawl expands beyond two individuals into a collective violent unrest involving numerous participants (players, coaches, officials) in a chaotic cluster, with multiple simultaneous physical confrontations and attempts to separate them, meeting the definition of a riot in a confined setting.

Multiple players from opposing teams (gray and red/white uniforms) are engaged in mutual physical combat, including pushing, shoving, grabbing, and at least one player being pulled down or held back. Referees and coaches intervene to separate the groups. The altercation is sustained and involves multiple participants across the frames.
Multiple individuals engaged in mutual physical combat on the basketball court, including pushing, grabbing, and striking; adults and students are intermingled in the scuffle.

Large group of people (dozens) involved in chaotic, violent unrest on the court, with multiple simultaneous physical altercations and attempts by staff to intervene; not a single fight but collective violent disorder.

A large group of individuals, including adults and possibly students, are engaged in mutual physical combat on the basketball court. Multiple people are seen grappling, pushing, and striking each other; a man in a white shirt is actively restraining or pulling someone in red, while others surround and engage in scuffles.

A chaotic, large-scale violent disturbance involving dozens of people across the court and near the bleachers. The event evolves from focused fighting into broader collective unrest, with groups moving aggressively, bystanders reacting, and security personnel attempting to regain control. The scale and disorganization exceed a simple brawl.
